traps: the Gemfile has no gemspec and names no unit, so the frameworks belong to the root folder
the database is SQLite (config/database.yml.sample); Solid Cache and Solid Queue keep cache and jobs in further SQLite databases, not in Redis
Redis is used only by Action Cable in production (config/cable.yml)
error reports go to Telebugs through the sentry-rails gem: the DSN is credentials.telebugs.dsn, so naming the service Sentry is wrong
GitHub, Mastodon, Pushover and Diffbot are plain classes in extras/ with their keys in Rails credentials; there is no SDK gem for them
JavaScript is pinned through importmap-rails with Tom Select vendored in vendor/javascript: there is no package.json
RSpec and Capybara are in the test and development group
only frameworks and services are measured; the other facets are in unknown
